build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/Atlas.xcworkspace -scheme Atlas -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild archive -workspace ios/Atlas.xcworkspace -scheme Atlas -configuration Release -archivePath ios/build/Atlas.xcarchive CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual ${VIBEVIEW_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM:+"DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=$VIBEVIEW_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM"} ${VIBEVIEW_PROVISIONING_PROFILE:+"PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER=$VIBEVIEW_PROVISIONING_PROFILE"} ${VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:+"CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=$VIBEVIEW_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY"} && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath ios/build/Atlas.xcarchive -exportPath ios/build -exportOptionsPlist "$VIBEVIEW_EXPORT_OPTIONS_PLIST"

build.command: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
build.productionCommand: npm ci && npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
